spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact IDL edges: Web IDL enum conversion TypeError for invalid strings, prototype accessor descriptor shape, strict-mode write TypeError, and the valid-value construction — each with a real call.

interactive.rationale: One button runs five live probes and fills the expectation-vs-observed table; nothing precomputed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the TypeError, the readonly accessor and the honest pre-158 detection; all three are table rows.

edge_cases.rationale: This is the edge page: it also demonstrates the pre-158 fingerprint (invalid enum sailing through as an ignored unknown member) and explicitly refuses to read that as support.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5180947573112832 and the attribute spec section, and cross-links the reliability feature's analogous edge page.

conformance.rationale: The suite's readonly-accessor and invalid-enum assertions encode the same contracts as rows 1 and 2.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all five rows filled — descriptor absent, 'fastest' constructed without complaint (named as the pre-158 fingerprint), valid option constructed, read undefined, strict write not probed — with the honest verdict; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: the green-row pattern needs a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: wt-cc-edges-ran asserts the full row count with per-probe outcomes; all promises claimed.

design_system.rationale: ok/err cell inks on bg-paper at AA, always with full exception or descriptor text.

accessibility.rationale: Native button, caption + scoped-header table in an overflow wrapper, verdict is aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Confirm all five rows go green on Chrome 158+
openQuestions.detail: On a 158+ build, verify the descriptor row shows a getter with no setter, 'fastest' throws TypeError, the instance read returns 'low-latency' or 'default', and the strict write throws TypeError.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep expectation and observation as separate labelled columns; communicate failure states in text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The table's 158+ expectation column sits beside the observed column, and every observed cell carries the literal outcome text.

summary: IDL edge probes: enum conversion TypeError, readonly accessor shape, strict-write behavior and the ignored-unknown-member fingerprint. Driven on headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): honest pre-158 rows throughout, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
